end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using a known group as a guide.
Discussed that an estimate is a nearby, not exact, number.
Ananya identified 40 as close to 43 in one example.
The group-counting mix-up appeared once and was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 5 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to estimate a larger collection and connected “estimate” with an approximate number. Ananya used “40 is close to 43” and explained that an estimate is not exact. They sometimes counted the groups as though each group were one object; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, show small groups of objects, count one group, and ask Ananya to estimate the total before checking by counting.
